04cc3f47aff9726fc09d913a4e20a1723f3fea68ALeks ishmanovcvyatoslavka@gmail.comALeks ishmanovcvyatoslavka@gmail.com17847489402026-07-22T22:35:40+03:00feat: Exchange -> Google Calendar sync (DavMail + notification-safe syncer)One-way, notification-safe sync of a corporate Exchange calendar into Google,
staged so it plays nicely with reclaim.io: DavMail exposes Exchange as CalDAV,
syncer/sync.py reads events, strips attendees into the description, and writes
via the Google Calendar API with sendUpdates=none — so no invitation is ever
emailed to a colleague.

All deployment-specific values (Exchange host, username, UPN, target calendar
id) come from .env, which is gitignored; .env.example documents them. History
starts fresh here: the previous history embedded a real corporate host and
login and is retained in a private archive rather than published.

docs/issues/ carries the two issues from that archive, including the incident
report that motivated dropping vdirsyncer.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
